source.title: The effect of substrate stiffness on adult neural stem cell behavior

material: Photocrosslinked methacrylamide chitosan (MAC) hydrogel, 3.5 kPa (3.0 uL DMAP/NVP per g MAC), laminin-coated

formulation.evidence: Three crosslinked MAC scaffolds were synthesized using 1.5, 3.0 and 6.0 mL of 300 mg/ mL DMAP/NMP with 1 g of 2 wt% MAC in water
Three crosslinked MAC scaffolds were synthesized using 1.5, 3.0 and 6.0 mL of 300 mg/ mL DMAP/NMP with 1 g of 2 wt% MAC in water

processing.evidence: crosslinked with 2 min UV light (365 nm) exposure.
coated with laminin (5 mg/mL in neurobasal media; Invitrogen, Carlsbad, CA, USA) for 4 h.

youngs_modulus.evidence: resulting in scaffolds with EY equal to 0.80  0.18, 3.59  0.51 and 6.72  0.58 kPa, referred to as <1, 3.5 and 7 kPa, respectively.

biology.cell_type: adult rat SVZ-derived neural stem/progenitor cells (NSPCs)

culture_days.evidence: Immunohistochemistry for differentiation into (A) oligodendrocytes, (B) neurons and (C) astrocytes after 8 d of culture.

other_outcomes.evidence: The resulting cell doubling times on <1, 3.5 and 7 kPa MAC were 139.5, 111.4 and 185.67 h, respectively.
other_outcomes.name: cell doubling time

other_outcomes.evidence: 67.5  5.6% and 59.4  2.6% oligodendrocytes were observed on 3.5 and <1 kPa surfaces, respectively
other_outcomes.name: RIP+ oligodendrocytes

other_outcomes.evidence: The <1 kPa MAC resulted in 32.9  2.0% neurons whereas the 3.5 kPa resulted in 22.5 1.7% neurons and the 7 kPa in 11.6  0.8% neurons.
other_outcomes.name: bIII-tubulin+ neurons

other_outcomes.evidence: GFAP positive cells (astrocytes) only appeared in large colonies at low frequencies (1.9  0.4% on <1 kPa and 1.0  0.3% on 3.5 kPa)
other_outcomes.name: GFAP+ astrocytes

other_outcomes.evidence: followed by a 28.7  13.2 fold increase over day 0 on 3.5 kPa MAC surfaces
other_outcomes.name: GFAP mRNA fold change vs day 0

notes: Modulus measured after 1 d equilibration in PBS with protease inhibitors at 4 C. Maximal proliferation on this stiffness.
